summary: Learn social impact screening, assessment and monitoring using practical project exercises. Explore the course and its applied outputs.
lede: Social impact assessment examines how project activities may affect people and what measures can address those effects. Designed for social impact specialists, project planners and environmental and social advisers, the training covers screening, social baselines, evidence gaps, stakeholder mapping and impact pathways. Participants also practise assessing significance, documenting mitigation and residual impacts, building monitoring indicators and preparing a social management plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess how projects affect people and translate findings into project controls.
outcomes: Environmental and Social Management Systems Design
prerequisites: Recommended: familiarity with project planning or environmental and social risk work. No coding is required. Bring a project example or anonymised assessment material if you have it; the exercises can also use a supplied case scenario.
